name: Love 2 Quad
source:
One day, the most popular teacher at Akakura Academy, Aoi-sensei, approached Wataru and informed him that his help is needed and he must take off his clothes immediately. She was an agent of the secret international defence organization Cradle and asked him to aid in the battle against the enemy ’4D’. In order to defeat ’4D’, he must engage in ecchi activities to gain energy and defeat the enemy with the power of love! His little sister-like childhood friend Honoka, classmate Ermalit, expressionless Mirai from the future and tiny Chitose from the past lend their help. However, they aren’t sure what to do?! And so marked the end of his peaceful single life.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/09/13/september-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一天，赤仓学园最受欢迎的葵老师找到渡，告诉他需要他的帮助，且必须立刻脱衣服。她是秘密国际防卫组织Cradle的特工，请他协助对抗敌人「4D」。为击败「4D」，渡必须进行色情活动获取能量，再以爱的力量打败敌人！像妹妹一样的青梅竹马穗香、同班同学埃尔玛利特、来自未来的无表情少女未来和来自过去的小千岁都来帮忙，却都不知道该做什么？！渡平静的单身生活就此结束。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/09/13/september-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
